views.def:
SELECT id,
    customer_name,
    rating,
    branch,
    body_published,
    published_at,
    published_version,
        CASE
            WHEN (reply_status = 'published'::review_reply_status) THEN reply_body
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS reply_body,
        CASE
            WHEN (reply_status = 'published'::review_reply_status) THEN reply_published_at
            ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone
        END AS reply_published_at
   FROM review_submissions
  WHERE ((moderation_status = 'approved'::review_moderation_status) AND (consent IS TRUE) AND (body_published IS NOT NULL) AND (deleted_at IS NULL));
